title: Get and renew a Delaware accountancy license
authority: Delaware Division of Professional Regulation, Board of Accountancy
description: Certified public accountants, public accountants and their firms must hold a license from the Delaware Board of Accountancy. Application fees: CPA permit $187, CPA firm $226, PA permit $179, PA firm $195. The renewal fee is given at renewal, and a late renewal adds a fee of 50% of the renewal fee. Licenses expire June 30 of odd-numbered years.
renewal: Every two years on June 30 (odd-numbered years)

title: Get and renew a Delaware architect license
authority: Delaware Division of Professional Regulation, Board of Architects
description: Architects and architecture firms must hold a license from the Delaware Board of Architects. Application fees: architect $172, certificate of authorization (firm) $130. The renewal fee is given at renewal, and a late renewal adds a fee of twice the renewal fee. Licenses expire January 31 of even-numbered years.
renewal: Every two years on January 31 (even-numbered years)

title: Get and renew a Delaware chiropractor license
authority: Delaware Division of Professional Regulation, Board of Chiropractic
description: Chiropractors must hold a license from the Delaware Board of Chiropractic. Application fees: chiropractor $294. The renewal fee is given at renewal, and a late renewal adds a fee of 50% of the renewal fee. Licenses expire June 30 of even-numbered years.
renewal: Every two years on June 30 (even-numbered years)

title: Get and renew a Delaware dentist and dental hygienist license
authority: Delaware Division of Professional Regulation, Board of Dentistry and Dental Hygiene
description: Dentists and dental hygienists must hold a license from the Delaware Board of Dentistry and Dental Hygiene. Application fees: dentist $362, dental hygienist $117, anesthesia permit $96. The renewal fee is given at renewal, and a late renewal adds a fee of 50% of the renewal fee. Licenses expire May 31 of even-numbered years.
renewal: Every two years on May 31 (even-numbered years)

title: Get and renew a Delaware dietitian and nutritionist license
authority: Delaware Division of Professional Regulation, Board of Dietetics/Nutrition
description: Dietitians and nutritionists must hold a license from the Delaware Board of Dietetics/Nutrition. Application fees: dietitian/nutritionist $235. The renewal fee is given at renewal, and a late renewal adds a fee of 50% of the renewal fee. Licenses expire May 31 of odd-numbered years.
renewal: Every two years on May 31 (odd-numbered years)

title: Get and renew a Delaware electrician license
authority: Delaware Division of Professional Regulation, Board of Electrical Examiners
description: Electricians and electrical inspection agencies must hold a license from the Delaware Board of Electrical Examiners. Application fees: master electrician $203, limited electrician $127, journeyperson $105, residential electrician $105, apprentice $100, inspection agency $90. The renewal fee is given at renewal, and a late renewal adds a fee of 50% of the renewal fee. Electricians' and inspection agencies' licenses expire June 30 of even-numbered years, and inspection agencies' also June 30 of odd-numbered years.
renewal: Every two years on June 30 (even-numbered years); inspection agencies also in odd-numbered years

title: Get and renew a Delaware funeral director, funeral home and crematory license
authority: Delaware Division of Professional Regulation, Board of Funeral Services
description: Funeral directors, funeral establishments and crematories must hold a license from the Delaware Board of Funeral Services. Application fees: funeral director $220, limited funeral director $110, funeral establishment permit $400, crematory establishment permit $373, resident intern $80. The renewal fee is given at renewal, and a late renewal adds a fee of 50% of the renewal fee. Licenses expire August 31 of even-numbered years.
renewal: Every two years on August 31 (even-numbered years)

title: Get and renew a Delaware geologist license
authority: Delaware Division of Professional Regulation, Board of Geologists
description: Geologists must hold a license from the Delaware Board of Geologists. Application fees: geologist $240. The renewal fee is given at renewal, and a late renewal adds a fee of 50% of the renewal fee. Licenses expire September 30 of even-numbered years.
renewal: Every two years on September 30 (even-numbered years)

title: Get and renew a Delaware home inspector license
authority: Delaware Division of Professional Regulation, Board of Home Inspectors
description: Home inspectors must hold a license from the Delaware Board of Home Inspectors. Application fees: home inspector $333, trainee $186. The renewal fee is given at renewal, and a late renewal adds a fee of 50% of the renewal fee. Licenses expire August 31 of odd-numbered years.
renewal: Every two years on August 31 (odd-numbered years)

title: Get and renew a Delaware land surveyor license
authority: Delaware Division of Professional Regulation, Board of Professional Land Surveyors
description: Land surveyors and surveying firms must hold a license from the Delaware Board of Professional Land Surveyors. Application fees: surveyor $210, certificate of authorization (firm) $222, surveyor intern $150. The renewal fee is given at renewal, and a late renewal adds a fee of twice the renewal fee. Licenses expire June 30 of odd-numbered years.
renewal: Every two years on June 30 (odd-numbered years)

title: Get and renew a Delaware landscape architect license
authority: Delaware Division of Professional Regulation, Board of Landscape Architecture
description: Landscape architects and their firms must hold a license from the Delaware Board of Landscape Architecture. Application fees: landscape architect $368, certificate of authorization (firm) $45. The renewal fee is given at renewal, and a late renewal adds a fee of 50% of the renewal fee. Licenses expire January 31 of odd-numbered years.
renewal: Every two years on January 31 (odd-numbered years)

title: Get and renew a Delaware manufactured home installer and inspector license
authority: Delaware Division of Professional Regulation, Board of Manufactured Home Installation
description: Manufactured home installers and inspectors must hold a license from the Delaware Board of Manufactured Home Installation. Application fees: installer $342, inspector $218. The renewal fee is given at renewal, and a late renewal adds a fee of 50% of the renewal fee. Licenses expire September 30 of even-numbered years.
renewal: Every two years on September 30 (even-numbered years)

title: Get and renew a Delaware massage therapist and massage establishment license
authority: Delaware Division of Professional Regulation, Board of Massage and Bodywork
description: Massage therapists and massage establishments must hold a license from the Delaware Board of Massage and Bodywork. Application fees: licensed massage therapist $175, massage establishment $50. The renewal fee is given at renewal, and a late renewal adds a fee of 50% of the renewal fee. Licenses expire August 31 of even-numbered years.
renewal: Every two years on August 31 (even-numbered years)

title: Get and renew a Delaware physician, physician assistant and Eastern medicine practitioner license
authority: Delaware Division of Professional Regulation, Board of Medical Licensure and Discipline
description: Physicians, physician assistants, acupuncturists, midwives and other medical practitioners must hold a license from the Delaware Board of Medical Licensure and Discipline. Application fees: physician (MD or DO) $440, physician assistant $230, acupuncture or Eastern medicine practitioner $222, midwifery practitioner $222, genetic counselor $222, respiratory care practitioner $153, paramedic $30. The renewal fee is given at renewal, and a late renewal adds a fee of 50% of the renewal fee. Physicians, physician assistants, acupuncturists, midwives and polysomnographers expire March 31 of odd-numbered years, paramedics May 31 and respiratory care practitioners November 30 of even-numbered years.
renewal: Every two years: March 31 (odd-numbered years) for most, May 31 and November 30 (even-numbered years) for others

title: Get and renew a Delaware nurse license
authority: Delaware Division of Professional Regulation, Board of Nursing
description: Registered nurses, practical nurses and advanced practice nurses must hold a license from the Delaware Board of Nursing. Application fees: registered nurse $181, practical nurse $181, advanced practice registered nurse $181. The renewal fee is given at renewal, and a late renewal adds a fee of 50% of the renewal fee. Practical nurses' licenses expire February 28 of even-numbered years, and registered and advanced practice nurses' on February 28, May 31 or September 30 of odd-numbered years.
renewal: Every two years: February 28 (even-numbered years) for practical nurses; February 28, May 31 or September 30 (odd-numbered years) for registered and advanced practice nurses

title: Get and renew a Delaware nursing home administrator license
authority: Delaware Division of Professional Regulation, Board of Examiners of Nursing Home Administrators
description: Nursing home administrators must hold a license from the Delaware Board of Examiners of Nursing Home Administrators. Application fees: nursing home administrator $309, administrator-in-training $55. The renewal fee is given at renewal, and a late renewal adds a fee of 50% of the renewal fee. Licenses expire July 31 of odd-numbered years.
renewal: Every two years on July 31 (odd-numbered years)

title: Get and renew a Delaware occupational therapist license
authority: Delaware Division of Professional Regulation, Board of Occupational Therapy Practice
description: Occupational therapists and assistants must hold a license from the Delaware Board of Occupational Therapy Practice. Application fees: occupational therapist $236, occupational therapy assistant $96. The renewal fee is given at renewal, and a late renewal adds a fee of 50% of the renewal fee. Licenses expire July 31 of even-numbered years.
renewal: Every two years on July 31 (even-numbered years)

title: Get and renew a Delaware optometrist license
authority: Delaware Division of Professional Regulation, Board of Examiners in Optometry
description: Optometrists must hold a license from the Delaware Board of Examiners in Optometry. Application fees: therapeutic optometrist $362. The renewal fee is given at renewal, and a late renewal adds a fee of 50% of the renewal fee. Licenses expire June 30 of odd-numbered years.
renewal: Every two years on June 30 (odd-numbered years)

title: Get and renew a Delaware pharmacist and pharmacy license
authority: Delaware Division of Professional Regulation, Board of Pharmacy
description: Pharmacists and pharmacies, including wholesalers and manufacturers must hold a license from the Delaware Board of Pharmacy. Application fees: pharmacist $226, retail pharmacy $403, hospital pharmacy $403, wholesale pharmacy (distributor) $875, pharmacy manufacturer $875. The renewal fee is given at renewal, and a late renewal adds a fee of 50% of the renewal fee. Licenses expire September 30 of even-numbered years.
renewal: Every two years on September 30 (even-numbered years)

title: Get and renew a Delaware physical therapist and athletic trainer license
authority: Delaware Division of Professional Regulation, Examining Board of Physical Therapists and Athletic Trainers
description: Physical therapists, assistants and athletic trainers must hold a license from the Delaware Examining Board of Physical Therapists and Athletic Trainers. Application fees: physical therapist $193, athletic trainer $193, physical therapist assistant $174. The renewal fee is given at renewal, and a late renewal adds a fee of 50% of the renewal fee. Licenses expire January 31 of odd-numbered years.
renewal: Every two years on January 31 (odd-numbered years)

title: Get and renew a Delaware river and bay pilot license
authority: Delaware Division of Professional Regulation, Board of Pilot Commissioners
description: River and bay pilots must hold a license from the Delaware Board of Pilot Commissioners. Application fees: apprentice pilot $195. The renewal fee is given at renewal, and a late renewal adds a fee of 50% of the renewal fee. Pilots' licenses expire November 30 each year.
renewal: Every year on November 30

title: Get and renew a Delaware plumber and HVACR contractor license
authority: Delaware Division of Professional Regulation, Board of Plumbing, Heating, Ventilation, Air Conditioning and Refrigeration Examiners
description: Plumbers and heating, ventilation, air conditioning and refrigeration contractors must hold a license from the Delaware Board of Plumbing, Heating, Ventilation, Air Conditioning and Refrigeration Examiners. Application fees: plumber $173, master HVACR $173, master restricted HVACR $173. The renewal fee is given at renewal, and a late renewal adds a fee of 50% of the renewal fee. Licenses expire October 31 of even-numbered years.
renewal: Every two years on October 31 (even-numbered years)

title: Get and renew a Delaware podiatrist license
authority: Delaware Division of Professional Regulation, Board of Podiatry
description: Podiatrists must hold a license from the Delaware Board of Podiatry. Application fees: podiatrist $353. The renewal fee is given at renewal, and a late renewal adds a fee of 50% of the renewal fee. Licenses expire June 30 of even-numbered years.
renewal: Every two years on June 30 (even-numbered years)

title: Get and renew a Delaware professional counselor, therapist and chemical dependency professional license
authority: Delaware Division of Professional Regulation, Board of Mental Health and Chemical Dependency Professionals
description: Professional counselors, marriage and family therapists, art therapists and chemical dependency professionals must hold a license from the Delaware Board of Mental Health and Chemical Dependency Professionals. Application fees: any counselor, therapist or chemical dependency license $272. The renewal fee is given at renewal, and a late renewal adds a fee of 50% of the renewal fee. Licenses expire September 30 of even-numbered years.
renewal: Every two years on September 30 (even-numbered years)

title: Get and renew a Delaware psychologist license
authority: Delaware Division of Professional Regulation, Board of Examiners of Psychologists
description: Psychologists and psychological assistants must hold a license from the Delaware Board of Examiners of Psychologists. Application fees: psychologist $305, psychological assistant $120. The renewal fee is given at renewal, and a late renewal adds a fee of 50% of the renewal fee. Licenses expire July 31 of odd-numbered years.
renewal: Every two years on July 31 (odd-numbered years)

title: Get and renew a Delaware social worker license
authority: Delaware Division of Professional Regulation, Board of Social Work Examiners
description: Social workers must hold a license from the Delaware Board of Social Work Examiners. Application fees: LCSW, MSW or BSW $205. The renewal fee is given at renewal, and a late renewal adds a fee of 50% of the renewal fee. Licenses expire January 31 of odd-numbered years.
renewal: Every two years on January 31 (odd-numbered years)

title: Get and renew a Delaware speech-language pathologist, audiologist and hearing aid dispenser license
authority: Delaware Division of Professional Regulation, Board of Speech Pathologists, Audiologists, and Hearing Aid Dispensers
description: Speech-language pathologists, audiologists and hearing aid dispensers must hold a license from the Delaware Board of Speech Pathologists, Audiologists, and Hearing Aid Dispensers. Application fees: any license type $175. The renewal fee is given at renewal, and a late renewal adds a fee of 50% of the renewal fee. Licenses expire July 31 of odd-numbered years.
renewal: Every two years on July 31 (odd-numbered years)

title: Get and renew a Delaware veterinarian and veterinary technician license
authority: Delaware Division of Professional Regulation, Board of Veterinary Medicine
description: Veterinarians and veterinary technicians must hold a license from the Delaware Board of Veterinary Medicine. Application fees: veterinarian $210, veterinary technician $130. The renewal fee is given at renewal, and a late renewal adds a fee of 50% of the renewal fee. Licenses expire July 31 of even-numbered years.
renewal: Every two years on July 31 (even-numbered years)

title: Get and renew a Delaware real estate broker and salesperson license
authority: Delaware Division of Professional Regulation, Real Estate Commission
description: Real estate brokers, associate brokers, salespeople and real estate offices must hold a license from the Delaware Real Estate Commission. Application fees: broker $248, associate broker $229, salesperson $149, main or branch office $192. The renewal fee is given at renewal, and a late renewal adds a fee of 50% of the renewal fee. Licenses expire April 30 of even-numbered years.
renewal: Every two years on April 30 (even-numbered years)

title: Get and renew a Delaware real estate appraiser and appraisal management company license
authority: Delaware Division of Professional Regulation, Council on Real Estate Appraisers
description: Real estate appraisers and appraisal management companies must hold a license from the Delaware Council on Real Estate Appraisers. Application fees: licensed, residential or general appraiser $333, appraiser trainee $282, appraisal management company $1,200. The renewal fee is given at renewal, and a late renewal adds a fee of 50% of the renewal fee. Licenses expire October 31 of odd-numbered years.
renewal: Every two years on October 31 (odd-numbered years)

title: Get and renew a Delaware controlled substance registration
authority: Delaware Division of Professional Regulation
description: Practitioners, pharmacies, hospitals, researchers and distributors who handle controlled substances must hold a license from the Delaware Division of Professional Regulation (controlled substance program). Application fees: practitioner or pharmacy registration $210, hospital or clinic registration $321, distributor or manufacturer registration $1,285. The renewal fee is given at renewal, and a late renewal adds a fee of 50% of the renewal fee. Licenses expire June 30 of odd-numbered years.
renewal: Every two years on June 30 (odd-numbered years)

title: Get and renew a Delaware cosmetologist, barber and nail technician license
authority: Delaware Division of Professional Regulation, Board of Cosmetology and Barbering
description: Cosmetologists, barbers, nail technicians, aestheticians, electrologists and instructors must hold a license from the Delaware Board of Cosmetology and Barbering. Application fees: cosmetologist or barber $128, nail technician $103, aesthetician $101, electrologist $103, instructor $205. The renewal fee is given at renewal, and a late renewal adds a fee of 50% of the renewal fee. Barbers, nail technicians, electrologists, aestheticians and instructors expire March 31 of even-numbered years, and cosmetologists October 31 of even-numbered years.
renewal: Every two years: March 31 (barbers, nail technicians, aestheticians) or October 31 (cosmetologists), even-numbered years

title: Get and renew a Delaware cosmetology or barber shop and mobile salon license
authority: Delaware Division of Professional Regulation, Board of Cosmetology and Barbering
description: Salons, barber shops and mobile salons must hold a license from the Delaware Board of Cosmetology and Barbering. Application fees: establishment or shop $142, mobile salon or shop $142. The renewal fee is given at renewal, and a late renewal adds a fee of 50% of the renewal fee. Licenses expire June 30 of odd-numbered years.
renewal: Every two years on June 30 (odd-numbered years)

title: Get and renew a Delaware cosmetology or barber school license
authority: Delaware Division of Professional Regulation, Board of Cosmetology and Barbering
description: Cosmetology and barbering schools must hold a license from the Delaware Board of Cosmetology and Barbering. Application fees: school $133. The renewal fee is given at renewal, and a late renewal adds a fee of 50% of the renewal fee. Licenses expire June 30 of odd-numbered years.
renewal: Every two years on June 30 (odd-numbered years)

title: Get and renew a Delaware charitable gaming (bingo, raffles and instant games) license
authority: Delaware Division of Professional Regulation, Board of Charitable Gaming
description: Organizations and vendors that run bingo, raffles, instant games or other charitable gaming must hold a license from the Delaware Board of Charitable Gaming. Application fees: instant or sealed games, per year $321, bingo or charitable gaming event, per event date $15, single-date raffle $15, Texas Hold'em tournament, per event date $250, charitable gaming vendor $400. The renewal fee is given at renewal, and a late renewal adds a fee of 50% of the renewal fee. Instant or sealed games licenses expire June 30 each year, and event licenses are bought per event date.
renewal: Instant or sealed games licenses on June 30 each year; event licenses per event date

title: Get and renew a Delaware adult entertainment establishment license
authority: Delaware Division of Professional Regulation, Commission on Adult Entertainment Establishments
description: Adult entertainment establishments, including bookstores, shows and retail must hold a license from the Delaware Commission on Adult Entertainment Establishments. Application fees: bookstore or shows establishment $2,200, adult retail establishment $430. The renewal fee is given at renewal, and a late renewal adds a fee of 50% of the renewal fee. Licenses expire July 31 each year.
renewal: Every year on July 31

title: Get a Delaware on-premises liquor license
authority: Delaware Office of the Alcoholic Beverage Control Commissioner
description: A restaurant, bar, hotel, caterer or other venue that serves alcohol needs an on-premises license from the Office of the Alcoholic Beverage Control Commissioner. Most licenses are biennial. Fees from the OABCC schedule: restaurant $1,000 (beer and wine only $500), hotel $1,000, taproom $1,000 (beer and wine only $500), brew pub $2,000, beer garden $2,000, caterer $1,000 plus $500 for off-premises catering, cabaret $2,000, bowling alley $1,000, concert hall or movie theater $1,500, golf course (multiple activity club) $1,500, private club $300 or $600 by membership, bottle club $300, and $500 per event for a temporary large event. An application that needs vetting or a public hearing carries a $1,000 non-refundable processing fee, and a Sunday sales permit ($500) and a patio permit ($1,000) are biennial add-ons.
renewal: Most Delaware liquor licenses are biennial, renewable every two years

title: Get a Delaware liquor store license
authority: Delaware Office of the Alcoholic Beverage Control Commissioner
description: A store that sells alcohol to take away needs an off-premises license: $1,000 for a store, plus $150 each for in-store tastings and for growler filling. A wine auction is $1,500, and a restaurant, hotel or taproom that also sells to take away pays $1,000 and must hold an on-premises license. An application that needs vetting or a public hearing carries a $1,000 non-refundable processing fee, and the license is biennial.
renewal: Most Delaware liquor licenses are biennial, renewable every two years

title: Get a Delaware alcohol wholesaler or supplier license
authority: Delaware Office of the Alcoholic Beverage Control Commissioner
description: Wholesalers and suppliers of alcohol need an OABCC license. Fees: spirits wholesaler $7,500, beer wholesaler $3,000, wine wholesaler $3,000 ($200 if it imports fewer than 1,000 cases a year), direct shipper $100, and an out-of-state supplier $1,000 (unlimited) or $100 (fewer than 200 cases a year). An application that needs vetting or a public hearing carries a $1,000 non-refundable processing fee, and the license is biennial.
renewal: Most Delaware liquor licenses are biennial, renewable every two years

title: Get a Delaware brewery, distillery or winery license
authority: Delaware Office of the Alcoholic Beverage Control Commissioner
description: Makers of alcohol need an OABCC manufacturing license. A brewery (beer, cider and mead) pays $1,500 under 25,000 barrels a year, $3,000 for 25,000 to 50,000, $6,000 for 50,000 to 100,000, and $9,000 above 100,000, with beer bottling $100 per 500 barrels. A craft distillery pays $1,500, and a winery (wine, cider and mead) $1,500. A distiller pays $100 for the first 500 gallons plus a per-gallon rate on larger volumes. An application that needs vetting or a public hearing carries a $1,000 non-refundable processing fee.
renewal: Most Delaware liquor licenses are biennial, renewable every two years

title: Get a Delaware nonprofit gathering alcohol license
authority: Delaware Office of the Alcoholic Beverage Control Commissioner
description: An eligible nonprofit that serves alcohol at an event needs an OABCC license. A daily gathering license is $5 for up to two days, $2 for each additional day, and $5 more for Sundays and holidays. A biennial license is $200 for fewer than 25 events, $400 for 25 to 75 events and $1,000 for more than 75, each with an added fee for Sundays and holidays ($200, $300 or $400). A nonprofit wine auction is $50.

title: Renew your Delaware pesticide business license
authority: Delaware Department of Agriculture, Pesticide Management
description: A business that applies pesticides to another person's property for pay needs a Delaware pesticide business license, with at least one certified commercial applicator and general liability insurance with completed operations of at least $300,000 for bodily injury per occurrence and $100,000 for property damage. The license expires each December 31, or sooner if the insurance policy does. The department sends renewal notices by October 1, and a renewal received after January 1 pays a 20% late penalty. Vehicles in some categories must show the license number.

title: Renew your Delaware restricted-use pesticide dealer permit
authority: Delaware Department of Agriculture, Pesticide Management
description: A business that sells restricted-use pesticides needs a Delaware pesticide dealer permit for each location where they are made available, and the permit is valid through December 31 of each year. The permit holder is responsible for employees who solicit, sell or recommend pesticide use.

title: Register your Delaware bee colonies each year
authority: Delaware Department of Agriculture, State Apiarist
description: Anyone keeping bees in Delaware, from one hive to a hundred, including migratory colonies and bees kept for others, must register online on or before January 30 each year and tell the State Apiarist within 10 days of getting bees. A violation carries a civil penalty of $100 to $1,000 per count.

title: Get a Delaware hemp producer, processor or handler license
authority: Delaware Department of Agriculture, Hemp Program
description: Growing, processing or handling hemp in Delaware needs a license from the Department of Agriculture. A producer license costs $300 (application window November 1 to February 1), a processor license $300 (apply by October 31) and a handler license $100. Growing sites are registered each year at $500 per site, and processing facilities at $1,000 per year. Producer and processor licenses are renewed every 3 years.
renewal: Producer and processor licenses renew every 3 years; growing sites and processing facilities register each year

title: Get a Delaware agricultural dealer license
authority: Delaware Department of Agriculture, Food Products Inspection
description: Dealers who buy agricultural products from producers or auction markets in Delaware, including Delaware brokers and out-of-state brokers, must be licensed and bonded by the Department of Agriculture under 3 Del. C. Chapter 25. The department's list shows each licensee's bond number and an expiration date, most of them March 31. The page gives no fee or bond amount.

title: Register commercial feed, pet food and fertilizer products in Delaware
authority: Delaware Department of Agriculture, Agriculture Compliance
description: Commercial feeds, pet foods, fertilizers, soil conditioners and liming materials must be registered with the Department of Agriculture's Agriculture Compliance section before they are sold in Delaware. Registration is online (feed other than dog or cat food, pet food, and fertilizer are separate), and a commercial fertilizer mixing facility also registers. The page gives no fees or renewal dates.

title: Get a Delaware nursery industry license
authority: Delaware Department of Agriculture, Plant Industries
description: A business that grows, distributes or sells nursery stock, Christmas trees or cut flowers in Delaware needs a Nursery Industry License from the Department of Agriculture's Plant Industries section, applied for online through the department's nursery portal. The licenses and permits page gives no fee or term.

title: Get the Delaware livestock dealer and meat and poultry establishment licenses
authority: Delaware Department of Agriculture
description: Anyone buying or selling livestock or poultry needs a livestock dealer's license, and an establishment that slaughters, prepares, buys, sells, transports or stores livestock or poultry products for human consumption needs a meat and poultry products establishment license, both from the Department of Agriculture. The licenses and permits page gives no fees or terms.

title: Renew your Delaware insurance producer, adjuster or agency license
authority: Delaware Department of Insurance, Producer Licensing
description: Insurance producers, adjusters, appraisers, surplus lines brokers, public adjusters, limited lines producers and business entities licensed in Delaware renew every two years through the Department of Insurance. Non-resident individual and business licenses must be renewed by February 28, 2027. A name change is a $50.00 filing. The page does not state the resident deadline or the renewal fees.
renewal: Every two years; non-resident licenses by February 28, 2027

title: Renew your Delaware licensed lender license
authority: Delaware Office of the State Bank Commissioner
description: A consumer lender, mortgage lender or short-term lender licensed under Chapter 22 of Title 5 renews each year by December 1. The renewal fee is $250.00 for each licensed location, and short-term consumer and title lenders also pay a $1,500.00 surcharge per location. The renewal needs updated principals and owners, a recent balance sheet and income statement, a business plan, and a surety bond or letter of credit; an application without every fee counts as late.

title: Renew your Delaware mortgage loan originator license
authority: Delaware Office of the State Bank Commissioner
description: An individual who originates mortgage loans for a licensed lender, mortgage loan broker, independent processor or manufactured housing finance company must be licensed through NMLS. Applying costs a $250 investigation fee and a $30 NMLS processing fee, and a $250 licensing fee is paid to the Office once approved. NMLS renewals open November 1 and are due by December 1, with the licensing fee collected again. The Office also bills a $500 supervisory assessment each July, due by August 1.

title: Get and renew the other Delaware State Bank Commissioner business licenses
authority: Delaware Office of the State Bank Commissioner
description: The Office of the State Bank Commissioner licenses businesses that cash checks, drafts or money orders, sell checks or transmit money, finance motor vehicle sales, carry money and valuables, and sell preneed funeral contracts. Each has its own renewal application on the Office's license renewals page, and any outstanding invoices must be paid before a renewal can be approved. The page does not list fees or deadlines.
renewal: Renewal applications are filed with the Office each year

title: Register your Delaware underground storage tanks each year
authority: DNREC Division of Waste and Hazardous Substances
description: Owners of underground storage tanks register them with DNREC each year at $150, plus $50 if the renewal is late. A business that installs, removes or tests tanks needs UST contract certification, $750 for the business and $300 for each individual, renewed every 2 years. These fees took effect December 21, 2025 under House Bill 175.

title: Get and renew Delaware well, pump and septic contractor licenses
authority: DNREC Division of Water
description: DNREC licenses water well contractors ($250 a year) and well drillers ($100 a year plus a $100 exam), pump installer contractors ($250 a year) and pump installers ($100 a year plus a $100 exam), and septic contractors of every class ($100 a year, no exam fee). A late renewal adds $50 for each license except septic contractors, who pay no late fee. A wastewater operator license is $100 every 2 years, with a $100 exam fee and a $50 late fee, and a waste transporter permit is $500 every 5 years. These fees took effect December 21, 2025.
renewal: Licenses renew every year

title: Get Delaware stormwater and wastewater discharge permits
authority: DNREC Division of Water and Watershed Stewardship
description: DNREC charges for stormwater and discharge permits. Industrial stormwater needs an application ($250) and an annual fee of $250 for a general permit or no-exposure certification, or $2,500 for an individual permit. A construction general permit notice of intent is $195 a year, and sediment and stormwater plan review costs $500 a plan or $975 an acre for a detailed review. An NPDES discharge permit application is $250 plus an annual impact fee of $0.25 per 1,000 gallons, up to $20,000. These fees took effect December 21, 2025.
renewal: Annual impact fees are paid every year

title: Get Delaware air quality permits for equipment that emits pollutants
authority: DNREC Division of Air Quality
description: Equipment that can discharge air contaminants needs a DNREC air permit. The fee schedule lists construction permit fees such as $800 for fuel-burning units and $24,000 for Prevention of Significant Deterioration review, plus annual fees and Title V operating permit fees. Fees changed on December 21, 2025 under House Bill 175.

title: Get Delaware wetlands, subaqueous lands and marina permits
authority: DNREC Wetlands and Waterways
description: Work in wetlands or on subaqueous lands needs a DNREC permit: wetlands permits, renewals and transfers are $450, most subaqueous permits $250, a subaqueous lands lease application $250 (renewed every 10 years) and a dredging application $250. A new major marina permit is $5,000 and a new minor one $2,000; alterations are $1,000 or $500. Fees took effect December 21, 2025.

title: Renew your Delaware motor vehicle dealer license
authority: Delaware Division of Revenue and Division of Motor Vehicles
description: A motor vehicle dealer needs a $100 Division of Revenue license, renewed on or before December 31 each year, plus a $2 motor vehicle handling fee per vehicle paid quarterly. A dealer that also sells for resale, parts or service pays a separate $75 license for each activity, and a finance or small loan agency license is $450. The DMV also licenses dealers separately.

title: Renew your Delaware adult-use cannabis license
authority: Delaware Office of the Marijuana Commissioner
description: Growing, making, testing or selling adult-use cannabis in Delaware needs a license from the Office of the Marijuana Commissioner, valid for 2 years. Each application has a non-refundable fee of $5,000 ($1,000 for social equity and $3,000 for microbusiness). An open retail store, manufacturing or testing license costs $10,000, and $4,000 for social equity, and a cultivation license is $2,500 to $10,000 by size tier. Social equity and microbusiness licenses cost 40% of the open license, and social equity licensees renew by paying the 40% fee and documenting a labor peace agreement. The office is no longer accepting applications.
renewal: Licenses are valid for 2 years and renewed biennially

title: Get and renew Delaware health care facility licenses
authority: Delaware Division of Health Care Quality
description: The Division of Health Care Quality licenses long-term care and other health facilities in Delaware. It has initial and renewal applications for skilled and aide-only home health agencies, hospices and personal assistance services agencies, and renewal applications for adult day care centers, dialysis centers, freestanding birthing, emergency and surgery centers, hospitals and prescribed pediatric extended care centers, and it licenses skilled nursing homes and assisted living facilities. Blueprint review is a separate application. The Division's forms page lists no fees or renewal dates.
renewal: Renewal applications are filed with the Division
